game_title: Unit Trader – Lava Tube Tunnel Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel, a glowing lava tube: the volcanologist must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Unit Trader: Convert units using expressions so each trade of cooling flasks is fair.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel: a glowing lava tube
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava Tube Tunnel, repeat each round: Convert units using expressions so each trade of cooling flasks is fair. Each round, a new cooling flasks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the fair_trades value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 140 points of cooling flasks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 140, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 2 (intro tier): Unit Trader
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Unit Trader' (Week 2 slot 14), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Lava Tube Tunnel'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how fair_trades changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against lava imps in Lava Tube Tunnel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 140 within 33 seconds.
